BiblicalUsage: Sâqar carries the sense of to ogle, that is blink coquettishly. It stands in Isaiah 3:16: "…walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God put sâqar here on purpose, and I take his word for it.
